% Fixture: xelatex-fontspec
%
% Purpose: verify XeLaTeX engine selection and fontspec usage.
%
% Expected maketex behaviour:
%   - Engine: xelatex (NOT pdflatex)
%   - Passes: 1
%   - Aux tools: none
%   - Output: main.pdf  (via .xdv → xdvipdfmx pipeline)
%
% XeLaTeX produces an intermediate .xdv (extended DVI) file before converting
% to PDF via xdvipdfmx.  The driver must invoke xelatex (not pdflatex) and
% handle the two-stage pipeline.
%
% fontspec allows loading system OpenType/TrueType fonts by name, which is the
% primary reason to use XeLaTeX over pdflatex.

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fontspec}

% Use a universally available font to keep the fixture portable.
% Latin Modern is part of every TeX Live installation.
\setmainfont{Latin Modern Roman}

\title{XeLaTeX Fontspec Test}
\author{Test Fixture}
\date{2026-06-07}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\section{Introduction}
This document is compiled with \texttt{xelatex} and uses the
\texttt{fontspec} package to load a system OpenType font.
A single pass should suffice --- no cross-references or bibliography.

\end{document}
